heading: INT. DECOMMISSIONED LIGHTHOUSE - "INNOVATION LANTERN" OPEN-PLAN FLOOR - MORNING

units.text: INT. DECOMMISSIONED LIGHTHOUSE - "INNOVATION LANTERN" OPEN-PLAN FLOOR - MORNING
Salt has crept into every corner of the converted tower, and the beanbags have gone faintly green with it.
Five desks spiral up the inner wall like the thread of a screw, each one lit by a bulb that flickers whenever the old beam mechanism groans overhead.
DELPHINE OKONKWO-REYES, fifties, a woman who laminates her own compliments, stands at a whiteboard that reads SYNERGY IS A VERB in three different colors of marker.
BARNABY "BARN" TULLY, thirties, a sales lead in a vest too clean for the sea air, sits cross-legged on a beanbag, tapping a stylus against his teeth.
YUKI HASEGAWA, late twenties, the only one with a real coffee, watches the whiteboard the way one watches a slow leak.
OSWALDO "OZZIE" PRIETO, sixties, the building's last maintenance man, oils a hinge nobody asked him to oil.
MAEVE KILLORAN, forties, finance, holds a printout against her chest like a shield.
Team. Team! Gather. Today we pivot from silos to... lighthouses.
units.name: DELPHINE

units.text: Del, we are in a lighthouse.
units.name: BARN

units.text: Which is why it's authentic, Barn.
units.name: DELPHINE

units.text: Yuki sets her cup down very gently.
Delphine, the quarterly lease line is eleven percent of --
units.name: YUKI

units.text: Forty. It's forty percent, Yuki, I told you it was forty --
units.name: MAEVE

units.text: Beam's been out since March, you know.
units.name: OZZIE

units.text: Ozzie, bless you, we're not discussing the beam --
units.name: DELPHINE

units.text: Maeve, hang on, if it's forty then the pivot deck is wrong --
units.name: BARN

units.text: The pivot deck is a hostage note, Barn!
units.name: MAEVE

units.text: Ozzie, is the lower stairwell flooding or not?
units.name: YUKI

units.text: Little bit.
units.name: OZZIE

units.text: We call that "organic flow," Yuki.
units.name: DELPHINE

units.text: Maeve slaps the printout onto the nearest desk.
The stylus stops mid-tap.
Eleven months of "organic flow." Eleven months of kombucha on tap and not one invoice paid on time.
units.name: MAEVE

units.text: That's not on me, Maeve, I closed Halloran --
units.name: BARN

units.text: You closed Halloran with a refund clause --
units.name: YUKI

units.text: Everybody, breathe. Ozzie, tell them it's fine.
units.name: DELPHINE

units.text: Ozzie wipes his hands on a rag, slowly, and looks up the long spiral of desks to the dead lamp.
Del. Honest answer? The tower's got a lean.
units.name: OZZIE

units.text: Silence.
Then the whiteboard slides an inch down the wall and the marker tray clatters to the floor.
Nobody leaves until we align.
units.name: DELPHINE

units.text: Maeve sweeps the printout off the desk and rips it in two, then in four.
Barn is on his feet.
Yuki is already pulling on her coat.
Align this, Del.
units.name: MAEVE

units.text: She throws the pieces.
They flutter down the stairwell like snow.
